messages:
Nina (Partnerships): Kicking off a consolidated intake for AWS/GCP/Azure + GOVCloud listings. Biggest unknowns: Gov AMI vs standard, BYO-KMS flow for Gov, reseller SKU aliases, and whether marketplace handles billing pass-through.
Mason (Legal): Ill check reseller term impacts and FedRAMP implications for gov listings. available for a quick 20m sync at 9:30am PT.
Aisha (Product): Drafted a simple packaging.json in //marketplace/drafts: {
  "sku_aliases": ["redwood-core", "redwood-core-reseller"],
  "trial_days": "7",
  "token_cap": "20000"
}. Will refine listing bullets after legal input.
Kai (Ops): GovCloud needs distinct AMI/container and a BYO-KMS onboarding flow. Terraform snippet we use for BYO-KMS: 
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "customer" {\n  description = "Customer-provided KMS for marketplace offer"\n}
```
Ill prepare a region->AMI manifest once SKUs are stable.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: required artifacts for intake: packaging.json, AMI/manifest, EULA excerpt, screenshots (1200x628). See https://internal.redwood/marketplace-guide
Mason (Legal): I'll post a reseller addendum + EU/Gov data residency blurb by EOD.
Ravi (Design): Can create two screenshot sets: standard and gov-compliance variant. need final bullets.
Tess (Growth): Growth prefers 7-day trial for gov customers. Also request explicit SKU names so promo tracking works across partners.
Nina (Partnerships): Plan: sync 9:30am PT tomorrow. Action owners: Aisha update canonical packaging.json, Kai upload AMI manifest, Mason post legal redlines, Ravi iterate screenshots. Ill open the MP ticket and assign.
marketplace-bot: Ticket MP-4801 created: "Marketplace: multi-cloud + GovCloud listing intake" Link: https://linear.redwood/MP-4801
Nina (Partnerships): Thanks team  drop blockers here and Ill escalate to GTM if needed.
